Project.title: Project
Project.description: A multimedia portfolio project containing titles, descriptions, categories, thumbnails, tags, and optional video URLs.

title.description: The name or title of the project.

description.description: A short summary of the project.

details.description: A detailed narrative of the project context and creative output.

category.description: Category of project (motion, video, design, ad).

thumbnailUrl.description: URL to thumbnail image or poster image of the work.

videoUrl.description: Optional video URL (YouTube, Vimeo, dynamic embed).

tags.description: A list of tools and technologies used.

isFeatured.description: Whether the project is featured on the hero splash or front page.

Video.title: Video
Video.description: A separate multimedia video asset or reel item for dynamic gallery loading.

Testimonial.title: Testimonial
Testimonial.description: Feedback or endorsement from dynamic clients/partners.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Contact form submissions from external visitors.

projects.description: The collection of multimedia works and projects.

videos.description: The collection of standalone video uploads or embedded links.
